china_race_dynamics.text: We need electricians. We need people that will be ahead of the game because AI is coming. We can’t lag behind China or any of the other countries. [...] We have to be on top of it, which is part of what’s happening right here today.

deepseek.reason: The speaker explicitly says the US cannot lag behind China and must be on top of AI.
